trafficGoal.measurementRule: Count only non-operator sessions with a verified external search referrer; direct and unknown traffic remains unverified.

content.selectionPolicy: Routine same-day coverage is independent of trends and historical keyword volume. Use Bing, Google Trends, and Search Console afterward to backfill missed dates and expand materially undercovered queries or topics.

search.googleIndexedPagesEvidence: Minimum confirmed by URL Inspection; aggregate Pages report is still processing
search.googleHomepageIndexStatus: URL is on Google; page is indexed; HTTPS valid
search.googleDiffuseIndexStatus: URL unknown to Google; no crawl yet; no referring sitemap detected in URL Inspection
search.googleIndexingReportStatus: Processing data; check again in a day or so
search.googleLinksReportStatus: Processing data; check again in a day or so
search.manualIndexingStatus: Candidates prepared; no request submitted without action-time confirmation
search.publicSearchSiteQueryStatus: No stable site-query result detected yet; GSC URL Inspection confirms the homepage is indexed
search.productionRobotsStatus: search=yes; Allow: /; sitemap and feed declared
search.bingSiteScanRemediation: Generated document titles are now capped at 70 characters; verify with a later rescan.

deployment.mode: GitHub Actions verified artifact direct upload

outreach.approvalNeeded: Sender name plus authorization to send two emails; sender email is also required for the ACPT form.

nextAction.action: Run the evening evidence check: Cloudflare Web Analytics with bots excluded, Pageview, Google Search Console, Bing sitemap/index/performance, and the latest Bing Site Scan. Count only verified non-operator search-referred human sessions.
